title: The Three AntiTablets
description: I had a collection of 3D assets, and wanted to experiemnt with a new world-lighting plugin. I staged the collection of objects on the table, and experimented with lighting to make an interesting “golden hour” effect.  I have been told that this image looks “AI” because it is so deeply weird.

image.alt: Collection of 3D assets rendedered on a table with a weird depth of field. Experimenting with lighting

title: A Wolf?
description: An attempt at 3D modelling a wolf. While the modeling and texturing of the wolf is clearly unfinished, I found that it looked interesting to show the unfinished wolf on a grassy landscape.  The lighting quite intentionally removes any visible detail about the wolf, keeping it in shadow. This image works really well at small scales.

image.alt: An attempt at 3D modelling a wolf

title: Silicon Mold Making Setup
description: This is a render of an example of what a setup could be to create a silicone mold of a pottery handle I made.  Unfortunately this project did'nt go anywhere.  I am rather impressed at how well I 3D modeled the actual real-life setup I used. However, rather than working cleanly, like things do in a render, this became a whole-ass mess.

image.alt: A 3D render of a tall tube in a transparent plastic bin, atop a craft mat. There is also a handle and a spray can in the setup.

title: Lonely Tree
description: A digital painting of a lonely willow tree. I liked how I used pastel colors, and focued on using minor perturbations in hue to create texturing. This painting was inspried by the willow in my fictional work, Huetopia.

image.alt: Digital painting of a tree without leaves
